figures.alt: Two black images, one with a grey band, one with a blue band; below, a crop pair and two tables.
figures.numbers: The gains, absolute 8 and signed 32 (the default of --signed-gain), and the section titles are those of compare_command and write_index in Tools/LookDev.py at the pin; the crops are the capture's, enlarged 4 times. The counts and cells are left as names: the drawing shows the layout, not one run.
